Name: Banners
Summary: Hero slides, carousels and announcement bars that editors write and schedule, shown anywhere on the site through template functions.
Guide:
A banner has a title, a subtitle, Markdown text, a button, an image, a tone and an optional window in which it is shown. Use one instance per place banners appear, for example banners for the slides on the home page and notice for a bar at the top of every page.

Add it to the site

app.Use(
    banners.Module("banners", "Banners"),
    banners.Module("notice", "Notices"),
)

The key (banners) is the instance's name in the admin and in the template functions and must be unique on the site. The title (Banners) is what editors see in the admin navigation. The module has no options.

Show banners

Banners are not placed on a page and the instance is not offered under Shows on this page in the page editor. Templates show them with two functions:

  • banners returns the active banners of an instance, in their order.
  • banner returns the first active banner, or nothing.

A banner is active when it is published, has a title in the page's language and the current time is inside its window. The window is checked whenever a page is rendered, so a banner appears and disappears without anyone publishing it. A page the output cache keeps shows the change once it is rendered again, after a minute by default.

Slides on the home page:

{{range banners "banners"}}
    <section class="slide">
        {{if .ImageURL}}<img src="{{.ImageURL}}" srcset="{{.ImageSrcset}}" sizes="100vw" width="{{.ImageWidth}}" height="{{.ImageHeight}}" alt="">{{end}}
        <h2>{{.Title}}</h2>
        <p>{{.Subtitle}}</p>
        {{.Text}}
        {{if .ButtonURL}}<a class="button" href="{{.ButtonURL}}">{{.ButtonLabel}}</a>{{end}}
    </section>
{{end}}

A notice bar in the layout:

{{with banner "notice"}}
    <div class="notice notice-{{.Tone}}" role="status">
        <strong>{{.Title}}</strong> {{.Text}}
        {{if not .Ends.IsZero}}Until {{date .Ends}}.{{end}}
    </div>
{{end}}

.Text is the rendered Markdown, with media from the library resolved. .ImageURL is the image as pages show it, at most 1600 pixels wide, with .ImageSrcset, .ImageWidth and .ImageHeight for the img tag; .ImageOriginalURL is the uploaded file. For wider screens, {{srcset .ImageURL 800 1600 2400}} offers larger copies (see Media and images). .ImageURL and .ButtonURL are empty when the banner has none. .Tone is info, success or warning (banners.ToneInfo, ToneSuccess, ToneWarning), meant as a CSS class. .Starts and .Ends are the window, zero when that side is open; date shows them in the site's timezone.

Editing

Each instance has its own section in the admin (/admin/banners; /admin is the default admin path).

  • Per language a banner has a title, a subtitle, Markdown text and a button label and address, so each language can link to its own page. The address is a path on this site, such as /en/contact, an anchor on the page, such as #opening-hours, a full http(s) URL, or a mailto: or tel: link; other kinds, such as javascript:, and addresses with spaces in them are refused. Spaces around the title, subtitle, button label and address are removed.
  • The image (from the media library), the tone (Information, Success or Warning) and the window are shared by all languages.
  • Show from and Show until are entered in the site's timezone. An empty Show from shows the banner as soon as it is published, an empty Show until until it is unpublished. The overview marks banners outside their window as Upcoming or Expired.
  • The order in the admin (Move up, Move down) is the order of banners, and decides which banner banner returns.
  • There are no revisions: saving changes the banner at once, also when it is published. Publish and Unpublish show or hide it; publishing needs a title in the site's default language.
  • Move to trash moves a banner to the trash, where it can be restored or deleted for good.

Editors' rights are set per instance in the groups' permission matrix.

Banners are not part of the site search or sitemap.xml.

Links to addresses on the site in the text and button addresses of published banners count for Links to a page: the editor of a page lists the banners that link to it, and Pages › Broken links lists their links that lead nowhere. A banner has no address of its own, so its relative links count from the home page of its language.

From Go

banners.Of(app, "banners") returns the instance once the app has started:

slides := banners.Of(app, "banners")

active, err := slides.Active(ctx, "en")

Store() gives write access for imports and seed data, through the same rules the admin uses. A banner needs a tone; the window is in UTC, with nil for an open side. New banners are saved unpublished:

ends := time.Date(2026, 12, 24, 17, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
store := banners.Of(app, "notice").Store()

item, err := store.Save(ctx, content.Draft[banners.Fields, banners.Text]{
    Fields: banners.Fields{Tone: banners.ToneWarning, Ends: &ends},
    Translations: []content.Translation[banners.Text]{
        {Locale: "en", Text: banners.Text{Title: "Closed on Christmas Eve from 17:00"}},
    },
})
if err != nil {
    return err
}

err = store.Publish(ctx, item.ID, "", "en")

Related modules

  • Gallery shows the photos of an album, for example as a carousel.
  • Testimonials adds quotes from customers to the same home page.
  • Lists keeps ordered blocks such as services or features.

Funcs.Name: banner
Funcs.Doc: first returns the first active banner of an instance, or nil, for example {{with banner "notice"}} in the layout.

Funcs.Name: banners
Funcs.Doc: active returns the active banners of an instance in their order, for example {{range banners "hero"}} on the home page.

SQL.Name: postgres
SQL.SQL:
-- Banners are a collection (see package content). Times are UTC.
CREATE TABLE wt_banner (
    id         UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    instance   VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    published  BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    position   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_by UUID,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    deleted_by UUID,
    image_id   UUID,
    tone       VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
    starts_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ends_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX wt_banner_instance ON wt_banner (instance, position);

CREATE TABLE wt_banner_translation (
    item_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES wt_banner (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    locale       VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL,
    title        VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subtitle     VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    body         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    button_label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    button_url   VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (item_id, locale)
);

SQL.Name: mysql
SQL.SQL:
-- Banners are a collection (see package content). Times are UTC.
CREATE TABLE wt_banner (
    id         VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    instance   VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    published  BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    position   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
    created_by VARCHAR(36) NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_by VARCHAR(36) NULL,
    deleted_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
    deleted_by VARCHAR(36) NULL,
    image_id   VARCHAR(36) NULL,
    tone       VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
    starts_at  DATETIME(6) NULL,
    ends_at    DATETIME(6) NULL,
    INDEX wt_banner_instance (instance, position)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE wt_banner_translation (
    item_id      VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    locale       VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL,
    title        VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subtitle     VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    body         TEXT NOT NULL,
    button_label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    button_url   VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (item_id, locale),
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES wt_banner (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

Types.Name: Banner
Types.Doc: Banner is an active banner as templates see it.

Types.Name: Fields
Types.Doc: Fields are the language-independent parts of a banner. Starts and Ends are UTC; nil means the window is open on that side.

Types.Name: Item
Types.Doc: Item is a banner with its translations, as the store keeps it.

Types.Name: Service
Types.Doc: Service is one Banners instance, for the website's own code.

Types.Name: Text
Types.Doc: Text is a banner in one language. Body is Markdown. ButtonURL is a path on the site, such as /en/contact, or a full URL.
Types.Decl:
type Text struct {
	Title       string `db:"title"`
	Subtitle    string `db:"subtitle"`
	Body        string `db:"body"`
	ButtonLabel string `db:"button_label"`
	ButtonURL   string `db:"button_url"`
}
